Balsamic Strawberries
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, March 8, 2010 - 12:09am

Ingredients




16 ounces fresh strawberries
 cup sugar
 cup balsamic vinegar

Preparation

1 This recipe takes about 90 seconds to prepare and the only dish you'll actually dirty is the serving dish! 2 Wash the strawberries and leave them somewhat damp. Transfer the strawberries to a sealable plastic bag. Add sugar to the bag and shake, making sure the strawberries are evenly coated. Next, add the balsamic to the bag and shake vigorously. The vinegar should be evenly distributed. 3 Serve immediately!
